---
title: "kubernetes_env"
description: "Real, generated bindings for `kubernetes_env`."
---

`kubernetes_env` -- real, typed bindings generated directly from the
`hashicorp/kubernetes` provider schema, in every SDK language.

## Example

<Tabs>
  <Tab title="Go">
    ```go
    import (
        "github.com/ubiquex/ubx-sdk-kubernetes/sdk/go/kubernetes/env"
    )

    cfg := env.EnvConfig{
        ApiVersion: "example",
        Kind: "example",
        Container: "example",
        FieldManager: "example",
    }
    ubx.Resource(env.Env, "example", cfg)
    ```
  </Tab>
  <Tab title="TypeScript">
    ```typescript
    import { Env } from
      "jsr:@ubx/sdk-kubernetes/kubernetes/env/env";

    resource(Env, "example", {
      apiVersion: "example",
      kind: "example",
      container: "example",
      fieldManager: "example",
    });
    ```
  </Tab>
  <Tab title="Python">
    ```python
    from ubx.kubernetes.env import Env, EnvConfig

    cfg = EnvConfig(
        api_version="example",
        kind="example",
        container="example",
        field_manager="example",
    )
    ubx.resource(Env, "example", cfg)
    ```
  </Tab>
  <Tab title="Markdown">
    ```
    Provision kubernetes_env with api_version, kind, container,
field_manager.
    ```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>
